intent: Acquire an authoritative, exact-component kinematic design-intent source for the proposed V43 Prism chain before selecting any hypothetical motion/endpoint test.

projected_steps.title: Locate a designer-authorized joint/actuation specification or exact native CAD mechanism definition for the seven V43 Prism targets
expected_outputs: source identity, authorship, revision and component-name mapping

projected_steps.title: Check whether that source explicitly binds each intended joint/guide, axis or direction, actuator, limits, and operating configuration
expected_outputs: source-bound candidate joint graph, or field-by-field unresolved status
no inference of force or reachability from point contact

projected_steps.title: Only if a candidate kinematic relation is source-bound, propose a separate bounded read-only hypothetical-state test and refresh live bindings before execution
expected_outputs: reviewable conditional test contract or explicit no-test decision
no live CAD motion or edits

acceptance_gate: Seven zero incident active-assembly mate results and point contact do not establish the intended mechanism. No motion, DOF, stroke, capture/release sequence, reaction capacity, or mechanical acceptance is granted without further authoritative evidence.
no_write_boundary: No move, rebuild, save, mate, suppression, selection, transform assignment, or Remote Queue write is authorized by this plan.
